neighbor.label: Housekeeper thread
neighbor.summary: The housekeeper, Fatima, arrives early, notices something is off, tries to reach Youssef several times, then calls the police.
insights: She reaches the house before dawn and spots an unusual light pattern.
She escalates and calls the police at 6:30am.

messages.author: Fatima
messages.text: I'm outside. Are you okay? Your lights are never on at this time.

messages.author: Fatima
messages.text: I'm ringing and there's no answer.

messages.author: Fatima
messages.text: Calling you again. Pick up please.

karim.label: Karim thread
karim.summary: Karim is upset about the deal, says he is coming over. Youssef invites him in to talk it out.

messages.author: Karim
messages.text: I'm coming over, I'm not sure what game you're playing

messages.author: Youssef
messages.text: All good man, relax. Come for a drink and let's chat

samir.label: Samir thread
samir.summary: A week earlier Samir is upset about a girl. The night of the incident he is drunk, not invited, and shows up anyway. The morning after he doesn't remember.
insights: Old grievance about a shared interest in a girl.
Drunk and insistent the night of the incident.

messages.author: Samir
messages.text: Dude, I told you not to kiss her - I LIKE her a lot

messages.author: Samir
messages.text: Honestly, pisses me off… I trusted you

messages.author: Youssef
messages.text: She doesn't even like you Sam, just chill.

messages.author: Samir
messages.text: Broo, I'm kind trashed.. Still upset!

messages.author: Samir
messages.text: Let's partyy a bit, I need a little sniff. A pick meupwdp

messages.author: Samir
messages.text: Donn't be like thatt, I'm comminn

messages.author: Samir
messages.text: Bro I passed out, I'm gunna have a shower n come down

messages.author: Samir
messages.text: Tell me what happened, if you're awake
